initial.chief_complaint: Burning when passing urine for two days.

presenting_complaint: Burning when passing urine for two days.
history_freetext:
For two days: burning on urination, passing small amounts of urine very often, urgency, mild pain above the pubic bone. The urine looks cloudy.
No fever or chills, no back or flank pain, no nausea or vomiting, no vaginal discharge or itching, no blood in the urine, no new sexual partner. No catheter, no recent urinary procedure or hospital stay.
Healthy. One similar episode about a year and a half ago that improved after antibiotics. No diabetes, no kidney stones, no kidney disease. Not pregnant: last period two weeks ago, uses oral contraception regularly.
Only the oral contraceptive pill. No known drug allergies.
